article.headline: CJ Hines hits game-winner, scores 23 as Alabama State rallies to beat UAPB 93-91
article.description: — CJ Hines scored on a layup at the buzzer and finished with 23 points as Alabama State rallied to beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff 93-91 on Monday night.
article.linkText: CJ Hines hits game-winner, scores 23 as Alabama State rallies to beat UAPB 93-91

categories.description: Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions @ Alabama State Hornets

event.description: Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions @ Alabama State Hornets

keywords: Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions @ Alabama State Hornets
article.story: MONTGOMERY, Ala. -- — CJ Hines scored on a layup at the buzzer and finished with 23 points as Alabama State rallied to beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff 93-91 on Monday night. Hines also contributed six rebounds for the Hornets (6-9, 2-0 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Amarr Knox added 20 points and Micah Octave scored 13. The Golden Lions (3-12, 0-2) were led by Doctor Bradley, who scored a career-high 35 in his second game of the season. Bradley, a junior who had a career-best 30 points in his first game, added seven rebounds and seven assists. Christian Moore had 19 points and Caleb Jones scored 15. Alabama State rallied after trailing 50-41 at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
